# Low_Voltage_Driving

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Operation of an actuation system using relatively low electrical potentials, reducing power consumption and safety risks. Facilitates integration with energy-constrained neuromorphic circuits and in-network processing nodes, improving overall system efficiency.
